name: session_workflow
description: A reviewable staged editing workflow with explicit recovery.

steps.purpose: Read the target and inspect current staged content; never assume a line position or a target match.
Read the backup, preparation, edit, review, validation, commit and readback workflow.
If validation fails, inspect the staged content. If source or commit conflicts occur, preserve the sidecar and analyze the external change before deciding how to proceed.

limits: Guidance only. This adapts a prototype workflow to Hornet's exact-text replacement API; it does not provide the prototype's line-index or bulk-edit methods.
